entries.title: Build Week source repository opened for public review
entries.summary: The Utopian Society Civic Portal source, timestamped Build Week history, testing instructions, infrastructure code, and Codex/GPT-5.6 collaboration record were published for public inspection. Software is provided under GPLv3 while the civic corpus and artwork retain separate content rights.
